description: This file contains PHP code for reassigning test case external IDs to internal IDs within a TestLink project. It includes logic for database interactions, session role checks, and tree traversal within test projects to update test case identifiers.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents a test case manager, instantiated to interact with test cases in the database.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project manager, instantiated to interact with test projects and their hierarchical structure.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Retrieves all test projects from the database.

methods.name: get_subtree
methods.description: Gets the subtree of nodes within a test project, with filters to exclude certain node types and children.
